items.review_rationale: Read limit ordinal by both nonzero restriction and absence of an ordinal predecessor whose successor equals lambda; kept successor distinct from set-theoretic maximal elements.

references.context: Empty von Neumann ordinal, excluded from the limit-ordinal convention used here.

references.disposition: Negative condition universally quantifies over ordinals; not a statement that lambda is an infinite cardinal.

items.review_rationale: Read successor ordinals using von Neumann set representatives, with alpha+1 equal to alpha union its singleton, distinguished from a numerical plus one in arbitrary ordered sets.

references.context: Set union of all members of ordinal alpha and the singleton containing alpha itself.
Canonical least ordinal strictly larger than alpha, concretely alpha union its singleton.

references.disposition: An ordinal is a successor precisely if it equals beta+1 for some ordinal beta.

items.review_rationale: Read von Neumann ordinal as a transitive set well-ordered by membership, including the least-element property and each member being a subset, without confusing the order with arbitrary numeric ordering.

references.context: Set alpha satisfying for each beta∈alpha that beta⊆alpha.
Relation beta∈gamma between ordinal elements beta,gamma inside alpha, with every nonempty subset having an ∈-least member.

references.phrase: every member of alpha is subset of alpha
references.disposition: The explicit transitivity condition is part of the ordinal definition, not optional inferred numeric comparison.
